label: Relative-totalization and physical-prime frontier
summary: Cross-sector descent now has a five-gate falsifier: finite symmetry becomes physical arithmetic only on an admissible fixed/support locus, with coherent coefficients, a source readout, and nonzero survival in the complete relative totalization.
changes: The physical bad-prime inventory is now {2,3}: prime three has independent cosmological occurrence-trace and string road-extension realizations.

Two existing prime-five candidates fail at different gates: the five-site cyclic fixed family is nonphysical at Gram rank three, while the five-point disk pairing descends before any trace is required.
The exact three-Cut first-residue packet falsifies four-gate sufficiency and adds survival in the complete relative totalization as the fifth gate.
The flavor one-loop phase line has no order-three in-place stabilizer, so ambient S3^3 chart symmetry does not become physical prime-three descent.
The finite-time cosmology audit isolates Eq. (19)'s boundary enhancement as an unsupported source normalization, not new carrier or coefficient structure.
